sections.Profile:
Hee Haw, released by Chicago Coin Machine Mfg. Co. in April 1973, is a four-player electro-mechanical pinball machine inspired by the American television show of the same name. Designed by John Gore with artwork by Christian Marche, the game features two flippers, two pop bumpers, a spinning target resembling a vinyl record, and multiple kick-out holes.

- Manufacturer: Chicago Coin Machine Mfg. Co.
- Years made: 1973
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 4
